final_candidates.decision_summary: T233 (verified as Thr in the given sequence) lies in a solvent-exposed region of domain II; an Ala substitution is small, conservative, and structurally tolerated. This site has precedent in flavivirus adaptation, supporting a modest fitness-gain hypothesis.

K251 (verified as Lys) is a charge-preserving, conservative substitution in a surface-tolerant region of domain I/II. It is unlikely to destabilize the E ectodomain while potentially tuning surface interactions.

H288 (verified as His) sits near the stem/helix region where aromatic substitutions can modestly tune pH-dependent maturation stability. Confidence is low due to limited structural rationale without external evidence.
